# Vendored Culori snapshot

`culori.js` is a readable, unminified ESM snapshot of the Culori 4.0.2 exports used by
Coloristic Core. It was generated from the official `culori@4.0.2` npm tarball with esbuild 0.28.1
using tree shaking and no minification.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/Evercoder/culori>
- Upstream npm integrity:
  `sha512-1+BhOB8ahCn4O0cep0Sh2l9KCOfOdY+BXJnKMHFFzDEouSr/el18QwXEMRlOj9UY5nCeA8UN3a/82rUWRBeyBw==`
- Snapshot SHA-256: `1262041dc2667d0775c25d0705320be7677495cc13fb0166fe6f7445afe4b8a1`
- License and attribution: [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

Any update must start from a verified upstream tarball, retain readable output, update the
attribution when required, record the new snapshot hash here, and pass the complete release gate.
